project_scope: Complete refactor of the SplashStickers sticker-configurator section (3 files: 285 lines Liquid, 2340 lines JS, 709 lines CSS = 3334 total). Modernize to Horizon OS 2.0 standards with SOLID principles, Web Component encapsulation, and 25 features across a 600mm canvas workspace.
business_deliverables: Working sticker configurator with add design/text, drag/resize, multi-select, delete/duplicate/flip/lock operations
6-direction alignment + distribute, brick-laying auto-arrange, snap-to-grid, DPR-aware grid rendering
Push-apart collision avoidance, grow canvas, 50-step undo/redo, zoom (min 100%), pan
Clipboard (Ctrl+C/V), export PDF (jsPDF), mobile mode with body scroll, auto-detect mobile
Touch handlers (drag/resize/pinch-zoom), SVG Lucide-style icons, custom modals, quantity/price display
Clean architecture: Web Component (ES6 class) with bounded contexts, CSS Custom Properties, schema-driven settings
No Turkish in code, no !important, no browser dialogs, no deprecated Liquid patterns

sections.name: sticker-configurator
sections.purpose: Main sticker configurator: canvas workspace with drag/resize/edit for sticker designs and text items. Includes toolbar, info bar, size inputs, canvas area with grid, sticky controls (upload, quantity, price, add-to-cart), and custom modals.

metafields.purpose: Base price per sticker sheet for dynamic pricing calculation

file_manifest.sections/sticker-configurator.liquid: 285 lines — Liquid template with schema, presets, locales, and Web Component mount point. Must remain lean; heavy logic lives in JS.
file_manifest.assets/sticker-configurator.js: 2340 lines — ES6 Web Component class (StickerConfigurator extends HTMLElement). Target: refactor into bounded modules, reduce monolith size, extract helper functions.
file_manifest.assets/sticker-configurator.css: 709 lines — Scoped styles under .sticker-configurator. CSS Custom Properties architecture. Mobile-first.

interaction_patterns: Hover states on toolbar buttons (bg #fff, color var(--cfg-primary))
Disabled buttons: opacity 0.25, no hover effect
Custom modals with backdrop, no browser dialogs
Focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements

mobile.canvas_wrap.height: set at init via CANVAS_H, NEVER cleared on mobile
mobile.canvas.style.height: set at init via CANVAS_H, NEVER cleared on mobile

item_operations: Add design from file upload (PNG, JPEG, SVG, WebP)
Add text items (T key or button)
history: History tracks: add, delete, move, resize, flip, text edit, duplicate, lock
mobile: Auto-detect: width<768 OR (touch device AND width<1024)
Tap-to-select first, then drag on second touch
ui_components: SVG Lucide-style icons (no external icon library)
Custom modal for adding designs (file picker + size + copies)
Custom modal for text editing (content, font size, color, background)
Price display (dynamic, based on item count × base price)
Info bar (item count, selection size, hint text)
clipboard: Preserves item properties (size, rotation, flip state)

architecture_constraints.pattern: ES6 Web Component (class extends HTMLElement, Light DOM)
architecture_constraints.state_management: Single this.state object (no external state library)
architecture_constraints.schema: JSON schema in {% schema %} with settings, presets, and locales
architecture_constraints.no_browser_dialogs: All confirm/alert/prompt replaced with custom modals

requirements: aria-label on all toolbar buttons (from schema locales)
Focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements
Semantic HTML structure (button, input, h2, p)
Keyboard navigation: Tab between controls, Enter/Space to activate
Disabled state styling for buttons (opacity change)

strategies: Grid canvas redraws only on zoom/resize/pan — not on every frame
No external library for icons (inline SVG)
jsPDF loaded on demand for export only

external_libraries.name: jsPDF
external_libraries.loading: dynamic import on export button click

dependencies.note: Hard bias against any non-vanilla frameworks. jsPDF is the only allowed external dependency.

web_component_spec.dom_strategy: Light DOM (no Shadow DOM — Shopify theme compatibility)

pipeline_sequence_notes: Refactor existing codebase, not new build. Architect must analyze current code, audit violations, propose clean boundary extraction (helper modules), and produce ADR. Constructor implements the refactor preserving all features. Optimizer handles performance. Auditor validates final output.
